schema.description: Request schema for updating a booking link

client_id.description: The ID of a client to pre-select. Pass `null` to clear.

expires_at.description: When the link should stop accepting new bookings. Pass `null` to clear.

locked_fields.description: Fields the public booker may not change on begotten booking intents.

max_uses.description: How many confirmed bookings the link may beget. Pass `null` for unlimited.

name.description: An optional label for the link.

provider_ids.description: Replaces the provider subset. Pass an empty array to restore the full service rotation.

schema.title: UpdateBookingLinkRequest
